findings.title: `queued` is evaluated once when the module is imported
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated while defining the dataclass, so every `AssignmentSource` constructed without an explicit `queued` value receives the same import-time timestamp rather than the time that webhook-triggered assignment was queued. This makes the context metadata incorrect for the lifetime of a worker process (and would break any future age/ordering logic based on this field). Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` so each instance captures its own creation time.
